title: ID0431485-DC/Si-D/SE [RVP/T5 170004804]SCB issues with latests deliveried dispensers.
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Latest dispensers that are deliveried is in the same serial number series as the main units that is built in Lepzig.
For example
Charger RVP/T5 170004804
Dispenser RVP/T5 170004844
This cases issues when adding the dispenser in scb as it doesn't accept that serial number. Please fix SCB.
